name: 2LIT
summary:
2LIT is one of a kind open-world driving, riding, diving, flying and street-culture game set in Widewater, a chaotic coastal city where horsepower, music, fame and bad decisions all collide. You arrive by cruise ship and get thrown into a city full of custom cars, illegal races, underground parties, beach chaos, shady businessmen, loud personalities and crews fighting for reputation.

Widewater is not just a racing map — it is a living playground. Cruise through neon docks, hotel districts, industrial yards
